# Architecture decision records

One decision per file, numbered sequentially: `NNNN-kebab-slug.md`.
Accepted ADRs are settled; supersede with a new ADR instead of editing the decision.
Agents: check this directory before proposing architectural changes; a written decision is not re-litigated in a task.
The template's own ADRs (why this repo is shaped the way it is) live in the bootstrap template repo.

Format (MADR-style, trimmed):

```markdown
# NNNN - Title stating the decision

Status: accepted (YYYY-MM-DD) | superseded by NNNN
Decided by: <user | agent, confirmed by user>

## Context

What forces are at play; why a decision is needed.

## Decision

What was decided, stated plainly.

## Rationale

Why this option won.

## Alternatives considered

What else was on the table and why it lost.

## Consequences

What this commits us to, including the costs.
```
